title: Subbing for Tommy Fulford with Chick Webb
summary: Ramirez played with Chick Webb occasionally when pianist Tommy Fulford, a schoolmate, was sick.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: Yeah. I played with Chick occasionally when Tommy Pulford(?) was sick.
Yeah. Tommy Pulford(?) and I went to school together. He's a piano player.
He was from Sixtieth Street, too.
No, I don't think so. Tommy was from 99th Street.
Which school did you go with him, then?
I don't remember. I think it was Cooper; it could have been Cooper. High school. Not in the early grade schools, you know.
